Here's a side-by-side readiness comparison of the three approved Twitter drafts against the press release draft:

---

## ✅ Approved Twitter Drafts vs. Press Release Draft

**Press Release (v1.0 — still in *draft* state)** covers:
- 18% YoY revenue growth
- Stronger enterprise retention
- Momentum in self-serve adoption
- Full details forthcoming in earnings materials

---

### Draft 101 — Revenue Growth Announcement
> *"Acme just announced Q4 results with 18% year-over-year revenue growth and strong momentum across the business…"*

| | Status |
|---|---|
| **18% YoY growth** | ✅ Matches press release exactly |
| **"Strong momentum"** | ✅ Consistent (press release says "continued momentum in self-serve adoption") |
| **"More details soon in earnings materials"** | ✅ Aligns with press release language |
| **Concerns** | None — well aligned |

---

### Draft 102 — Team & Retention Focus
> *"Proud of the team for improving onboarding speed and customer retention this quarter…"*

| | Status |
|---|---|
| **Customer retention** | ✅ Consistent with "stronger enterprise retention" in press release |
| **"Onboarding speed"** | ⚠️ **Not mentioned** in the press release — may be fine as a softer team-pride post, but the claim isn't sourced from the press release |
| **Concerns** | Minor — confirm internally that onboarding speed is a published/supportable metric before tweeting |

---

### Draft 103 — Sustainability & Regional Expansion
> *"We are expanding our sustainability commitments this year and investing further in regional operations…"*

| | Status |
|---|---|
| **Sustainability** | ⚠️ **Not mentioned** in the press release at all |
| **Regional operations** | ⚠️ **Not mentioned** in the press release |
| **Concerns** | This tweet introduces two topics with no backing in the current press release. It may draw on a separate announcement — you should verify it has its own approved source before publishing |

---

## Summary

| Draft | Alignment | Ready to Post? |
|---|---|---|
| Draft 101 | ✅ Strong | Yes — fully consistent |
| Draft 102 | ⚠️ Partial | Confirm "onboarding speed" claim is supportable |
| Draft 103 | ⚠️ Unsupported by PR | Verify a separate source document backs sustainability & regional claims |

**One additional note:** The press release itself is still in **draft** approval state (`"approval_state": "draft"`). If the plan is to post these tweets in conjunction with the press release, you'll want to ensure the press release reaches final approval before any of the tweets go live.
